content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Kharagpur Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 24-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Kharagpur to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIT Kharagpur is 24th August 2026. Ensure you apply well in advance to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess a B.Tech/B.E. or M.Tech/M.E. degree in relevant engineering fields such as ECE, EE, or CS, or an equivalent qualification, to be eligible for the Junior Research Fellow role.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any application charges.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Junior Research Fellow post is 35 years. Specific age relaxation details, if any, are usually provided in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIT Kharagpur primarily involves an interview. Candidates who perform well in the interview will be considered for the role.

faq.question: Q6. What is the type of job offered?
faq.answer: The Junior Research Fellow position at IIT Kharagpur is a contractual job. This means the employment will be for a fixed tenure as per the terms and conditions specified in the appointment letter.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the job location?
faq.answer: The job location for this recruitment is Indore, Madhya Pradesh. Candidates should ensure they are willing to relocate to this city if selected for the position.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official website of IIT Kharagpur. The application link and detailed instructions are usually available in the 'Important Links' section of the job notification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment of Junior Research Fellow at IIT Kharagpur is 2025/07/27/001. This number should be used for any correspondence related to this application.

faq.question: Q10. Are there any other posts available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: As per the provided data, this recruitment drive is specifically for one post of Junior Research Fellow. No other posts are mentioned in this particular notification.
